scope: Fixed experiment protocol for the revised VGA/AGC study. Parameters and selection criteria were fixed before simulation.
selection_policy: Ranges and random seeds fixed before runs; no redraw after performance is observed. Preserve failures and original comparisons. Report assumptions separately from simulated outcomes.

vga.fixed: Same educational MOS models, 1.8 V supply, 1 pF load, 1 pF internal compensation, behavioural detector and controller.
vga.stage_selection: Compare measured gain coverage, peaking and distortion at 350 mVpp. Prefer candidate with lower worst-case THD only if all five gains have <=1% gain deviation, <=1% THD, >=5 MHz BW and <=0.5 dB peaking. Preserve original 8x8 as comparison; report no pass if both fail.
vga.controller_selection: Meet +/-5% steady-state amplitude at all five nominal input levels and post-recovery control ripple <=0.10 mVpp at weakest input; among tested passing strengths choose shortest worse-direction recovery. Recovery must persist at least 20 carrier cycles. Preserve transient overload.
vga.validation: Half-step check for a dynamic transition and fixed-gain distortion. Cascade with revised TIA after standalone checks.
